entities.name: Lim Boo Liat
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lim Boo Liat was a Malaysian zoologist whose pioneering work revealed the biological diversity of the Malay Peninsula and Borneo. He was a conservationist and a strong advocate for the preservation of the region's natural heritage.
